items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I arrived and saw my old friend Edgar 'Spider' Caurance

ctx.x: Bobby was a Batchelor and had a four roomed apartment at Amsterdam Avennue on 161st Street. I had lived in that neighbourhood before and liked it very much. Leonard "Ham Davis, the trumpet man I spoke about when I first played the Savoy ballroom, lived in this building also. I did a few gigs with Bobby and some jam sessions around town. September 23rd, I was back at Town Hall for a concert called BIAJ which was presented by Specs Powell. BIAJ meant 'Best in American Jazz' and the musicians that performed were…

One night in October, I was coming out of one of the Clubs on 52nd Street and met a drummer named Herbie Cowens, who was known to meet musicians as "Kat". Herbie asked me if I would like to go to the Phillipines and maybe Japan. I didn't think that he was serious, but I told him 'yes' and gave him my address. A few days later, I received a message from Kat saying that the first rehersal and general meeting would be the 12th of October. I arrived and saw my old friend Edgar 'Spider' Caurance, Ernest 'Bass' Hill,…
